serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Pinecone is a fully managed vector database for AI applications. It stores, indexes, and
searches high-dimensional vector embeddings to power retrieval for semantic search,
recommendation, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) workloads. Customers create
indexes in a cloud region of their choosing and interact with the service through
documented APIs and client SDKs. The service is operated by Pinecone on public cloud
infrastructure, with customer data encrypted at rest (AES-256, with a distinct data
encryption key for every stored object, so no data key is shared between customers) and in
transit (TLS 1.2 minimum).
